race.comment: The Gluyas camp would've had a big red circle around this for their champ AIR ASSAULT (3). Was good without threatening first-up in the Behemoth over a trip far short of his best. Much better suited here second-up and carries the class edge. Sticky draw but Holder knows him like the back of his hand. CICALA (13) has progressed sharply in her last two and is ready to put it all together fourth-up. Yet to be tested at this trip but suspect she'll handle it. Has more upside than the rest. PUDDING (4) is a noted fresh performer and loves his home track. Draws well for Toeroek and always deserves respect. COTE ATLANTIQUE (2) comes through some strong races and has been holding his own. Loves this trip and is in the mix. Stable debut for ex-NSW trained WILLIAMSBURG (5). Has peaks that are up to this.
